author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a buggy relationship simulator. A GTA game in name only.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: Pragmata is a great game. The combination of hacking and shooting gameplay is very fun, and the story has plenty of wholesome and emotional moments. The MC is not a blank slate, as he has a personality and a backstory, which I appreciated. What made the game even better for me is the fact that it takes place on the Moon. If you love space and exploring areas on the Moon, you might really enjoy this game.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: This game is a must-play for anyone that enjoys video games. One of the best RPGs out there with a great plot twist that can only be done in a video game format.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: One of the best musou games. It has addictive gameplay and an engaging story. The devs balanced it really well.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: My childhood game. One of the best games ever. I still go back and play it after all these years.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: One of the most beautiful games I've ever played. There's not a thing I didn't like. It all tied well together. Thank you Hideo Kojima and everyone that worked on this masterpiece.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: I played this game because I loved the song ExoHuman. Casey Edwards is just that talented of a composer, and paired with the vocals of Robin Adams makes for a great song. I came into Exoprimal not knowing what to expect since there was a lot of negativity surrounding it online. What I got was a great gaming experience. It was so fun fighting all the dinosaurs, trying out different exosuits and aiming for a good score. What surprised me the most was the story. It was genuinely very good.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: Final Fantasy XVI is a lonely MMORPG experience in a single-player game. For the most part, it's just Clive and his furry companion Torgal going from one fetch quest to the next. The boss fights are largely cinematic, with simple QTE prompts. The story starts off very strong, but then quickly suffers from an identity crisis: Is it a political drama, or a traditional JRPG tale where a divine being is the BBEG? Most of the interesting characters die for the plot to progress, yet the less interesting ones remain. In that respect, it tries to pull an FFII but fails to stick the landing. Simply put, FFXVI is a game with a daring heart, but it was forced to play it safe.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: An amazing modern Final Fantasy game. It had everything I wished FF16 had. As a long-time FF7 fan, Rebirth did not disappoint me, but I did feel it dragged on a bit towards the end. Overall, it's a wonderful experience with lots of emotional moments on par with the Final Fantasy brand.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: The world of Stellar Blade is beautiful, accompanied by equally beautiful OST. The gameplay is very fun, it reminded me of Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance and NieR:Automata. The story starts fine, but it gets really good towards the end. I especially loved the 'Return to the Colony' ending and its boss fight.

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote:
Dragon's Dogma 2 has fantastic gameplay, with lots of options to explore for your Arisen and main pawn. Exploring the game's world with the pawns is never boring. If you're looking for a classic RPG tale with fun action-RPG gameplay and customisable characters, you've come to the right game. 

I wish I could give this game a 10, but sadly it is underdeveloped in certain areas. Still, I highly enjoyed it even in its current state. I can only imagine how amazing it would have been if its vision had been fully realised. Dragon's Dogma games will always hold a special place in my heart for their creativity. The ending of Dragon's Dogma 2 had me staring at the ceiling for a while, as I lay on my bed thinking, "At least they were together at the end."

author: Cruel_Adoration
quote: Astro Bot is a love letter to PlayStation and its players. It's a fantastic platform game with the world's most adorable little robot as the main character. Thank you Team Asobi :)
